representation: Same edit-topology/closed associations as topology-v1. Training accepts only original low_quality=N and reviewer label equal to generated label; no lexical/test filtering.
identity_supervision: Explicit supervised reflexivity over selected public train statements.
selection: One deterministic policy. All 646 validation and 1758 previously consumed test pairs evaluated, including confusing/low-quality examples. Report clean strata additionally, never replace the full denominator.
acceptance: Development experiment, not M1 approval. Compare validation, consistency and retention; no automatic promotion or M2 start.
limits: Current rule/genome/input caps and 300 seconds per process. No hidden model, second agent, RSS or energy claim.
